title: Aureline M5 portable-shelf reopen parity
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for the reopen-parity posture that keeps an exported portable shelf / bundle honest when it is reopened. Exported shelves must reopen as honest local / imported state rather than pretending to remain a live provider object: this object names the handoff channel the shelf travelled (browser companion, support escalation, incident bridge, offline follow-up, or review export), the reopen state (exported, imported, reopened as local, reopened as provider-linked, stale, or redacted), the reopened truth posture (local-only, provider-linked, stale provider link, or redacted profile) so an imported shelf never overclaims current hosted truth, the reopening actor (an explicit user command, a background agent, or broad automation), and whether the diff / evidence identity is preserved across export and reopen. Names the object class, its change-orchestration association, the handoff channel, the reopen state, the reopened truth posture, the reopening actor, and whether diff / evidence identity is preserved — so a change object or landing candidate can be exported and later reopened without losing diff / evidence identity, and an imported shelf clearly shows local-only, provider-linked, stale, or redacted state instead of overclaiming current hosted truth. Downstream the portable-shelf, patch-stack / queue, provider-landing, and support / export packets point at this schema instead of restating reopen-parity behavior by hand. Raw paths, raw provider payloads, secret values, and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
